summary: ITER-6 BLOCKER FIXED + ConfirmModal FULLY VERIFIED. Backend regression clean (31/31 pytest in 12.38s: auth, PATCH /auth/me, recipes, likes/saves/history, subscription, AI + save-generated + numeric coercion, meal-plan CRUD + gating, prefs + cuisines + skill_level). Frontend @ 390x844 against deployed URL, signed in as cook@owami.app: (1) Paywall confirm modal NOW OPENS after selecting $rc_monthly + tapping paywall-subscribe — modal shows 'Confirm your subscription' + 'Pro monthly · $9.99' + Not now/Subscribe. paywall-confirm-cancel dismisses, paywall-confirm-backdrop dismisses. Iter-6 identityReady=Platform.OS==='web'?!!user?.id fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:89 works. (2) signout-modal (row-signout) opens with 'Sign out of Owami?' + Cancel + Sign out; signout-modal-cancel dismisses, signout-modal-backdrop dismisses, signout-modal-confirm signs out and redirects to /auth/welcome. (3) delete-modal (row-delete) opens with 'Delete your account?' + danger red 'Delete forever' (delete-modal-confirm) + Cancel — delete-modal-cancel dismisses. (4) grep of profile.tsx confirms zero Alert.alert usage — replaced everywhere by ConfirmModal. (5) Offerings still render correctly (paywall-option-$rc_monthly Pro monthly $9.99, paywall-option-$rc_annual Pro annual Best value $15.99). (6) No red 'Purchases unavailable' banner. Delete-forever destructive path (real DELETE + old-token→401) NOT executed against cook@owami.app per instructions; throw-away registration flow could not be automated cleanly (Create your cookbook link was a Text node not directly clickable and multi-step onboarding varies), but ConfirmModal open/close/testID contract is fully validated on cook@ session, and DELETE /api/users/me is already covered by TestAuth::test_register_and_delete in backend_test.py (31/31 pass).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/confirm-modal.tsx is clean, self-contained (69 lines), correct testID contract: `${testID}`, `${testID}-cancel`, `${testID}-confirm`, `${testID}-backdrop`. Uses React Native Modal + Pressable absoluteFill for backdrop, ActivityIndicator for loading state, tone='danger' switches to colors.error. No hardcoded strings, all styles via StyleSheet.create.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx correctly wires two ConfirmModals (signout-modal + delete-modal) with a single `confirm` union state ('signout'|'delete'|null) and shared `busy` flag — clean pattern. Alert.alert is gone (grep confirmed).

/app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx correctly uses ConfirmModal with testID='paywall-confirm' and gates it behind identityReady. Web path shortcut (identityReady=!!user?.id) unblocks the flow. Confirms user-cancelled purchase is silently swallowed (test-store safe).

/app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx line 89 iter-6 shortcut `identityReady = Platform.OS === 'web' ? !!user?.id : sdkIdentityReady` is the correct workaround for purchases-js Browser Mode ignoring post-configure logIn. Safe because Test Store on web doesn't actually charge — this was documented inline (lines 83-88).

Dead styles left in paywall.tsx (confirmBackdrop, confirmCard, confirmH, confirmS, confirmBtn, confirmBtnGhost lines 208-214) — leftovers from before ConfirmModal extraction. Minor: consider removing to reduce noise, not a bug.
No file exceeds 700 lines. paywall.tsx=215, profile.tsx=180, confirm-modal.tsx=69, revenuecat.tsx=142.
